action->Exacting Strike.description: Chertus makes a Golpe. If he rolls a failure on this Golpe, the attack doesn't count toward his multiple attack penalizador.

action->Lunge.name: Acometer
action->Lunge.description: Chertus makes a Golpe with his fist and increases his reach by 5 pies for this Golpe.

action->Pummeling Flurry.name: Pummeling Flurry
action->Pummeling Flurry.description: Chertus swings his fist in a pummeling arc, then makes a fist Golpe and compares the tirada de ataque result to the AC of up to two adjacent foes. He then rolls daño and applies it to each criatura he hits. Este counts as two attacks for his multiple attack penalizador.

action->Snatch Arma.name: Snatch Arma
action->Snatch Arma.description: Chertus attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} a criatura. If he knocks a arma out of the opponent's grasp, Chertus wields the arma and attempts a Golpe against the opponent with the arma. Este counts as two attacks for his multiple attack penalizador.

Clockwork Serpent.name: Serpiente mecanica
Clockwork Serpent.publicNotes:
Las serpientes mecanicas suelen encontrarse sirviendo como guardianes en laboratorios o templos serpentfolk.

Serpientes experimentales

Se rumorea que en el corazon de enclaves serpentfolk existen serpientes mecanicas aun mas extranas. Estos constructos supuestamente pueden repararse a si mismos al cambiar de modo serpiente, activar formas adicionales que les permiten nadar o volar, o incluso descomponerse en un enjambre de pequenas serpientes mecanicas.

strike-melee->Coils.name: Coils
strike-melee->Coils.description: Requisitos The clockwork serpent is in constrictor mode

action->Wind-Up.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.xS8ybzuqPSi3Jb8k]
Wind-Up
action->Wind-Up.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.xS8ybzuqPSi3Jb8k]

24 horas, [[/act disable-device dc=26]]{DC 26 THIEVERY}, standby

For a clockwork to act, it must be wound with a unique key by another criatura. Este takes 1 minuto. Once wound, it remains operational for the listed amount of time, usually 24 horas, after which time it becomes unaware of its surroundings and can't act until it's wound again. Some clockworks' abilities require them to spend some of their remaining operational time. They can't spend more than they have and shut down immediately once they have 0 time remaining. If it's unclear when a clockwork was last wound, most clockwork keepers wind all their clockworks at a set time, typically 8 a.m.

A clockwork that lists standby in its wind-up entry can enter standby mode as a 3-action activity. Its operational time doesn't decrease in standby, but it can sense its surroundings (with a -2 penalizador to Perception). It can't act, with one exception: when it perceives a criatura, it can exit standby as a reaction (rolling initiative if appropriate).

A criatura can attempt to Disable a Device to wind a clockwork down (with a DC listed in the wind-up entry). For each success, the clockwork loses 1 hora of operational time. Este can be done even if the clockwork is in standby mode.

action->Activate Serpent Mode.name: Activar Serpent Mode
action->Activate Serpent Mode.description:
Desencadenante The clockwork serpent begins its turn

Efecto The clockwork serpent transforms into a different mode. Roll 1d3 and consult the options below. If it rolls a mode it can't currently activate, the clockwork serpent becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 1} until the start of its next turn. At the end of its turn, it automatically deactivates its serpent mode.

1 Cobra Mode The clockwork serpent can use Intimidating Hood.

2 Constrictor Mode The clockwork serpent can use its coils Golpe and can Constrict.

3 Rattlesnake Mode The clockwork serpent can use Shattering Rattle.

action->Critical Deactivation.name: Critical Deactivation
action->Critical Deactivation.description: If a clockwork serpent takes any daño de precisión or takes a impacto crítico and it has a serpent mode active, it must attempt a @Check[flat|dc:16]. On a failure, it takes the daño from the impacto crítico as normal, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1}, and its serpent mode deactivates.

action->Clockwork Serpent Venom.name: Clockwork Serpent Venom
action->Clockwork Serpent Venom.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:26]

Duración máxima 6 asaltos

Etapa 1 @Damage[2d6[poison]] daño and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[2d6[poison]] daño, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1}, and desprevenido (1 asalto)

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.g26YiEIfSHCpLocV]

action->Intimidating Hood.description:

Efecto The clockwork serpent flares out a cobra hood. All criaturas within a @Template[emanation|distance:15] must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:26] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2} on a critical failure).

action->Shattering Rattle.name: Shattering Rattle
action->Shattering Rattle.description:
Requisitos The clockwork serpent is in rattlesnake mode

Efecto The clockwork serpent rattles its tail, then snaps it like a whip to create a devastating blast of sonic energy in a @Template[cone|distance:30]. Las criaturas in the area take @Damage[9d6[sonic]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[fortitude|dc:26|basic|options:area-effect] salvación).

Coloxus.name: Coloxus
Coloxus.publicNotes: Aunque el coloxus tiene la cabeza grotesca de una mosca monstruosa, estos demonios son pulcros y cuidadosos, y siempre visten ropa elegante sin una sola mancha. Los coloxus son manipuladores y conspiradores nacidos de almas destructivamente vanidosas. Los mortales malvados disfrutan invocandolos para servir como emisarios o espias, pero tambien son asesinos excelentes. Incluso cuando actua como homicida, el demonio conserva una cortesía empalagosa y una preocupacion obsesiva por las apariencias.
Coloxus.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.kdhbPaBMK1d1fpbA]
Telepathy 100 pies

action->Filth Vulnerability.name: Filth Vulnerability
action->Filth Vulnerability.description: A coloxus despises contact with filth and dirt. A small amount of filth held in the hand can be used against a coloxus as a Golpe that has the thrown 5 pies rasgo, and that inflicts @Damage[2d6[mental]] daño on a hit. Forcing a coloxus to fall into or become immersed in filth deals @Damage[6d6[mental]] daño per round.

action->Vanishing Words.name: Vanishing Words
action->Vanishing Words.description:
Desencadenante The coloxus rolls initiative with DECEPTION or DIPLOMACY and can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility}

Efecto The coloxus casts 4th-rank invisibility on itself.

action->Droning Wings.name: Droning Wings
action->Droning Wings.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto The coloxus flutters its shimmering, gauzy wings and creates a mesmerizing display of color along with a sound-dampening buzzing drone. If the coloxus is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, that effect ends and it becomes visible. All criaturas within a @Template[emanation|distance:30] must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:29] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 2} on a critical failure) until the start of the coloxus's next turn. As long as Droning Wings continues, the coloxus gains immunity to daño sónico. The coloxus can Sustain Droning Wings for up to 1 minuto.

action->Siphon.name: Siphon
action->Siphon.description: When a coloxus damages a criatura with its jaws Golpe, it siphons away el objetivo's physical vitality and drinks from their sense of self-worth and confidence. The coloxus gains 10 Puntos de Golpe temporales, and the criatura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:32] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1}. Further daño dealt by the coloxus increases the anonadado condition by 1 on a failed save to a maximum of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 4}.

action->Sneak Attack.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

The criatura's Golpes deal an additional 2d6 daño de precisión to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criaturas.

Corpselight Mist.name: Corpselight Mist
Corpselight Mist.description: Churning vapors of glowing green mist fill a 30-pies-deep chasm.
Corpselight Mist.disable: @Check[religion|dc:28] a counteract Kabriri's influence here by offering prayers a cualquier non-evil deity y causing el mist a disperse, o @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel magia} (3rd rank; counteract DC 23) a counteract el mist durante 24 horas
Corpselight Mist.reset: El peligro se reinicia automaticamente al final de un turno y puede volver a activarse el siguiente asalto.

action->Decay Flesh.name: Decay Flesh
action->Decay Flesh.description:
Desencadenante A criatura ends its turn within the mist

Efecto The mist swiftly decays the flesh of all living criaturas in the pit, inflicting @Damage[10d6[void]] daño (@Check[fortitude|dc:27|basic] salvación).

Cruncher.name: Cruncher
Cruncher.publicNotes: Como a menudo se los describe solo en relatos ebrios de lenadores o mineros, muchos consideran que los hodags existen unicamente en el folclore de zonas remotas. Sin embargo, algunas personas se han encontrado de verdad con estas bestias peligrosas, y aun menos han vivido para contarlo. Los hodags son criaturas reptilianas del tamano de toros. Estos depredadores feroces tienen largas garras capaces de despedazar criaturas.

action->Trackless.name: Sin rieles
action->Trackless.description: Un hodag barre el suelo tras de si con la cola mientras se mueve, ocultando sus huellas. Las CD de las pruebas para @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Rastrear} a un hodag aumentan en 10.

action->Rip and Tear.name: Rasgar y despedazar
action->Rip and Tear.description: The hodag makes two claw Golpes and one jaws Golpe in any order.

action->Sickly.name: Sickly
action->Sickly.description:
Cruncher is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1} due to his mistreatment from the goblins. In addition, his eyes are rheumy and caked with gunk, resulting in a –4 penalizador por circunstancia to sight-based Perception checks and causing him to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} beyond a range of 5 pies. If he escapes into the wild, he heals back up after a few nights' rest and a big meal. Alternatively, a PC can speed his recovery with a @Check[medicine|dc:20] prueba, with the results detailed below; this takes 10 minutos to perform, and as such Cruncher needs to either be helpless or willing to receive the attention.

Éxito crítico Cruncher's vision clears and he loses the debilitado condition.

Éxito Cruncher's vision clears, and he'll lose the debilitado condition after 8 hours of rest.

Fallo The attempt provides no aid.

Fallo crítico As failure, but Cruncher takes @Damage[2d6] points of daño as well, potentially causing him to lose his trust in the PCs and driving him to attack.

action->Toss.name: Toss
action->Toss.description:
The hodag Strides, then makes a Golpe against a objetivo in reach. If it moves at least 20 pies and succeeds at its Golpe, the hodag deals daño normally and then attempts an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] prueba against the criatura's CD de Fortaleza to toss the enemigo into the air.

On a success, the tossed criatura is thrown 10 pies in a straight line in the direction of the hodag's choice and then lands @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}. If the criatura is knocked into a solid object, it takes @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] daño as well before landing prone. The hodag can instead toss a criatura straight up in the air. The criatura lands in the same square where it started, takes @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] daño, and lands prone.

Devil's Breath.name: Devil's Breath
Devil's Breath.description: El monstruo disecado se tambalea hacia delante, aulla y exhala una rafaga de humo pestilente.
Devil's Breath.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:23] a pluck out el taxidermy's gemstone eyes
Devil's Breath.reset: El Devil's Breath resets automatically after un hora.

action->Exhale Smoke.name: Exhale Smoke
action->Exhale Smoke.description:
Desencadenante A non-goblin criatura approaches within 10 pies of the taxidermy Sandpoint Devil

Efecto The taxidermy Sandpoint Devil lurches forward, opens its jaws, and emits a blood-curdling howl and a blast of foul-smelling gray smoke. All criaturas in a @Template[cone|distance:30] directed south of the trap (which reaches all the way to the door leading out to the Pit) must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1} for 1 hora (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2} for 8 hours on a critical failure).

arma->Machete.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.O7IZBvVoe7W2XnBa]

Este medium-length sword has a wide blade and long grip. Though it is typically used to hack through heavy foliage, the machete can also be used as a deadly arma.

action->Devil's Breath.name: Devil's Breath
action->Devil's Breath.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto The Devil's Disciple cuts their tongue with a slashing arma held in a hand (taking @Damage[1[slashing]] daño), then exhales a @Template[cone|distance:15] of burning smoke. Each criatura in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:18] salvación.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura takes @Damage[1d8[fire]] daño.

Fallo The criatura takes @Damage[2d8[fire]] daño and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} by the agonizing pain of the burns.

Fallo crítico The criatura takes @Damage[4d8[fire]] daño, is indispuesto 1 by the agonizing pain of the burns, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1} by the smoke for 1 minuto.

Divine Warden Of Haagenti.name: Guardian divino de Haagenti
Divine Warden Of Haagenti.publicNotes: Este guardian divino sirve a Nethys, el dios neutral de la magia. Usa su don divino para defender templos o santuarios de @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.9EKyWmjLUu42evxC]{Nethys}. Creados mediante complejos rituales realizados por fieles de una fe, los guardianes divinos han sido imbuidos con una fraccion del poder que fluye por un campeon o clerigo de una deidad concreta. Esa chispa divina permite al guardian servir como protector sagrado.

action->Divine Destruction.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.jD0M3yV6gjkXafsJ]
Divine Destruction
action->Divine Destruction.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.jD0M3yV6gjkXafsJ]

When the divine warden is reduced to 0 HP, it erupts with divine energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30], dealing @Damage[4d6[void]] daño. Each criatura in the area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:17|traits:damaging-effect] salvación with the following outcomes.

Éxito crítico The criatura takes half daño.

Éxito The criatura takes full daño.

Fallo The criatura takes full daño and becomes temporarily cursed by the patron deity. The criatura becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} for 1 día; this is a curse effect that uses the salvación de Voluntad DC as the counteract DC.

Fallo crítico As failure, except the criatura becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 2}.

action->Faith Bound.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.OPGu0WsUHpHSmu80]
Faith Bound

<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.UlKGxPaKtRGWuq3V]
Faithful Arma
action->Faithful Arma.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.UlKGxPaKtRGWuq3V]

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.War0uyLBx1jA0Ge7]{Battle Axe}, striking rune

A divine warden always wields its patron deity's favored arma. If the arma is a ranged arma, the divine warden automatically generates new ammunition with each attack. For a divine warden of 4th nivel or higher, the deity's favored arma gains the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.DxCuJKynlnMQZHgp]{Striking} rune while the divine warden wields it; at 12th nivel, these effects are of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.KCQRFvUgbyclvOGi]{Greater Striking} rune, and at 19th nivel, they're instead of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.woxl2FrrgAcJDu0t]{Major Striking} rune.

<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.L80gn6WOWi9roJW3]
Instrument of Faith

False Devil.name: Falso diablo
False Devil.publicNotes: Estos depredadores notorios tienen una sed innegable de sangre. Los chupacabras prefieren atacar a los debiles y lentos, a menudo ocultos y observando a una posible presa durante largo tiempo antes de lanzarse. Agiles y sigilosos, suelen establecer sus guaridas en zonas de hierba alta y rocas protectoras, donde sus escamas ligeramente reflectantes les permiten camuflarse bien. Prefieren alimentarse de viajeros solitarios, ganado y cualquiera que se separe de la seguridad del grupo.

action->Chupar.name: Chupar
action->Chupar.description:
Requisitos The chupacabra has a criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado}

Efecto The chupacabra sucks blood from the grabbed criatura. The chupacabra gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Acelerado} condition for 1 minuto and can use the extra action only for Golpe and Zancada actions. A chupacabra can't use Chupar again while it is quickened in this way.

A criatura that has its blood drenado by a chupacabra is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1} until it receives healing (of any kind or amount).

action->Pounce.name: Pounce
action->Pounce.description: The chupacabra Strides and makes a Golpe at the end of that movement. If the chupacabra began this action @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido}, it remains escondido until after this ability's Golpe.

action->Wing Flurry.name: Wing Flurry
action->Wing Flurry.description: The false devil's spiny wings don't afford it a typical melee option, but it can use them to scrape and slash at foes it flies by. The winged chupacabra attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} an enemigo's space. As it does so, it flaps its wings furiously, gaining a +2 bonificador por circunstancia to its Acrobatics prueba. If it succeeds, it inflicts @Damage[4d6[slashing]] daño to the criatura it Tumbled Through (or @Damage[8d6[slashing]] daño on a critical success).

Fear of the Devil.name: Fear of the Devil
Fear of the Devil.description: Un humo y fuego manifestation de el Sandpoint Devil emerges de el pit con un blast de foul-smelling humo.
Fear of the Devil.disable: @Check[diplomacy|dc:30] (maestro) to soothe and calm the unquiet fears left behind by the slain adventurers or @Check[religion|dc:30] (maestro) to hinder the haunt with prayers of protection (two successes from either skill disables the haunt)
Fear of the Devil.reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minuto after all criaturas leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.
Fear of the Devil.routine: (1 action; evocation, fire, occult) The smoking vision of the Sandpoint Devil appears to hover over the pit, its wings of fire flapping as its head lowers to exhale a @Template[cone|distance:30] of fire into the room, targeting as many criaturas as possible. Note that the geist can be targeted by this blast of fire as well, but remember that its resistance applies to the fire. All criaturas in the area take @Damage[7d6[fire]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic|traits:fire,occult] salvación). A criatura that critically fails this tirada de salvación is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}; this effect has the emotion, fear, and mental rasgos.

action->Brimstone Cloud.name: Brimstone Cloud
action->Brimstone Cloud.description:
Desencadenante A living criatura approaches within 10 pies of the pit's edge

Efecto A smoky, burning manifestation of the Sandpoint Devil appears to rise from the pit, causing a plume of brimstone-scented smoke to billow into the room. All criaturas in area H6 must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 2} on a critical failure). The haunt then rolls initiative.

Fiendish Flock.name: Bandada infernal
Fiendish Flock.publicNotes: Una bandada de cuervos se conoce en algunas lenguas como una crueldad, y el nombre cobra pleno sentido cuando un enjambre de cuervos decide actuar en conjunto. En la mayoria de casos, un enjambre como este no ataca a enemigos grandes, pero cuando es manipulado por fuerzas sobrenaturales o por la simple desesperacion del hambre, puede convertirse en una amenaza sorprendente. Pocas aves son tan astutas y sociales como el cuervo.

action->Beaks and Talons.name: Beaks and Talons
action->Beaks and Talons.description: The fiendish flock's angry pecking and clawing deals @Damage[2d6[piercing],2d6[slashing]] daño to each enemigo in the swarm's space (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] salvación). Fungus Tyrant.name: Fungus Tyrant
Fungus Tyrant.publicNotes:
Hundreds of years ago, a cadre of powerful succubus assassins invaded the Abyssal realm of the demon lord of disease and fungus, Cyth-V'sug. Estos succubi sought to slay a powerful witch who had befouled a profane temple the assassins served. The succubi failed at their mission, but from their corpses grew the first fungus tyrants. Pleased with this development, the witch then seeded numerous worlds on the Material Plane with fungus tyrant spores, who have since grown and thrived in their new environments as rot thrives in a corpse. Today, hundreds of fungus tyrants inhabit the fouler locales of the Material Plane. They're particularly fond of large cave systems and ruined cities, but also can be found in corrupted woodlands where blighted fey rule or in the sewers of active cities that spew vast amounts of magical waste.

An encounter with a normally unintelligent plant monster acting with methodical intent can be evidence of a fungus tyrant's manipulations, but fungus tyrants are equally fond of keeping other types of criaturas as pets and thralls—particularly attractive humanoids. Especially favored minions are given the gift of the fungus tyrant's embrace and are transformed into fungoid minions forever loyal to their pallid ruler. Yet most fungus tyrants realize that a diverse array of guardians is best, and they often elige to keep some non-fungus minions on hand to protect their lair.

Fungus tyrants are violently jealous. Any who attempt to lure away their dominated pets or cure those who have been infected by them earns their eternal ire. Yet it's succubi who enrage fungus tyrants the most. In these demons, the fungus tyrant sees a former glamour and power they no longer have access to, and only the brutal destruction of these mocking memories can salve a fungus tyrant's anger. A fungus tyrant faced with someone whom they suspect might be a succubus is terrible indeed, for in such battles, the fiendish fungal beings abandon their normal approach of subtle mental trickery and bring all of their power to bear in an attempt to rip the offending criatura apart. Fungus tyrants also take great delight in transforming succubi into fungoid criaturas under their control.

While their jealousy doesn't compel them to do battle with other fungus tyrants, they're always careful to maintain their own territories apart from any nearby kin, and they take great pains not to "poach" other tyrant's charmed and infested pets.

A fungus tyrant is 6 pies tall and weighs 150 pounds.

Spore Thralls

When a criatura becomes a spore thrall, it rises from death with the same statistics it had in life, but gains the fungus rasgo, as well as immunity to death effects, disease, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado}, and poison, and its alignment switches to match that of the fungus tyrant who created them. When a spore thrall is slain, its soul finally travels to the Boneyard for judgment, but the fungus-encrusted physical remains often spawn new fungal criaturas, such as myceloids, violet fungi, or drakauthixes. Estos fungal spawn are not controlled by the fungus tyrant but generally regard them as an aliado or, more often, a divinity.

After this time, the criatura is restored to life but gains the fungus rasgo and becomes a spore thrall. Este prevents the criatura's soul from continuing on to the afterlife in a similar manner to how undead are taken out of that cycle—as such, those who hold that cycle sacred (particularly worshipers of Pharasma) regard spore thralls as bad as the undead, despite them being living criaturas. They wander the world, looking for solace and never finding it. In frustration, they turn their malice back onto the living, antagonizing any nearby criaturas, hoping to fatally lure their victims into the clutches of a haunt to be turned into another geist and share the torment.

Geists are occasionally mistaken for other incorporeal undead, such as wraiths and ghosts, but their proximity to haunts is one of the surest ways to determine the NATURE of the undead being encountered.

Giant Longlegs.publicNotes:
The most widespread of the longlegs is the giant longlegs, a criatura with a body the size of a dog whose long, spindly legs give it a much more intimidating appearance.

While smaller specimens of these unsettling-looking arachnids (known regionally by names like harvesters, tickle spiders, or daddy longlegs) are harmless, their larger cousins, known simply as longlegs, are anything but.

Longlegs Species

Beyond the two common types presented here, many other variants of longlegs can be found throughout Golarion, with the exception of its arctic regions, where longlegs don't thrive. They often live on the periphery of cities, lurking in sewers or ruins where the hunting is good. Swarms of sewer longlegs are particularly dangerous and infest the undercities of many Taldan settlements, while to the west in Cheliax, the much-larger executor longlegs prefer to live among the rooflines of slums where Thrune's rule has been particularly horrific. Among the largest of all longlegs, though, is the dreaded (and thankfully rare) treeleg harvester of the Mwangi Expanse.

Greedspawn.name: Engendro de la avaricia
Greedspawn.publicNotes:
Sinspawn were created by one of seven ancient wizards known collectively as runelords-each of whom embraced and embodied one of seven sins. The first sinspawn was created by the Runelord of Wrath, utilizing techniques that have since gone on to influence fleshwarping practices. It wasn't long before the technique used to create sinspawn fell into the hands of the other runelords, and while each tried their own hand at CRAFTING variants of their own design, today sinspawn of wrath remain the most numerous and notorious of their kind. Bearing only a vague resemblance to the humanoids from whose flesh they were formed, sinspawn generally appear horrifically emaciated and have unnaturally long arms and digitigrade legs, each with a trio of stubby, taloned digits. Veins bulge across sinspawn's bodies in sanguine patterns that suspiciously resemble twisted runes, and their flesh is pale and hairless. Their heads are elongated, bearing only slits for a nose, red eyes, and disturbing lower jaws that split in half at the chin, revealing pedipalps that end in tiny, three-fingered hands and framing a long, lolling tongue. Sinspawn stand 6-1/2 pies tall and typically weigh as much as an emaciated human of their size. They behave in a manner consistent with their associated sin and have physical characteristics that hint at these qualities. For example, greedspawn's veins appear to run with gold while envyspawn appear even more wasted than the rest of their kin.

Greedspawn are the tallest of sinspawn, often 7 pies in height, and with gold-tinged veins.

Midnight milk is a strange and powerful drug, originally invented by the intellect devourers of the alien city of Ilvarandin to remotely steal the bodies of distant dreaming victims through the use of an artifact called the Dream Lens. Pure midnight milk is incredibly rare—almost all of that found beyond the vault of Ilvarandin is instead cut to reduce costs and expenses. Narlo Nyrell.publicNotes:
When a cleric rebels against their deity and dies in the grip of blasphemous rage, the heresies they committed in life may fuel their transformation into an undead herexen. Herexens seek vengeance against the deity they once worshipped, defiling temples, slaying the faithful, and rallying lesser undead and death cultists to aid them in their unholy quests. Though a herexen's divine gifts have mostly been corrupted into the vileness of undeath, they stubbornly cling to remnants of their former power, still wielding magic and armaments favored by the deity they so greatly despise.

Groups of herexens that blasphemed against the same deity sometimes combine to form a mockery of a congregation, conducting blasphemous rites with something approaching euphoria. Estos congregations are more often formed from a blasphemous cult who practiced their heresy together in life and died together, though some gather independent herexens of the same former faith.

Gosregs are agents of the Dominion of the Black that insinuate themselves into humanoid societies to foster the goals of their sinister alien masters. They act as spies and special forces that can mingle with humanoid SOCIETY while enacting plans for the rest of the Dominion in secret.

In their natural forms, gosregs dart about in a jerky gallop due to their stumpy legs and gangly arms. They take on the appearances of humanoids to infiltrate societies, and they drop their disguises only when they feel they are ultimately compromised and must resort to physical violence to protect their agendas. Sicklefang Longlegs.name: Sicklefang Longlegs
Sicklefang Longlegs.publicNotes:
Somewhat larger than el giant longlegs, el sicklefang es named for su unusually grande, curved mandibles, que ellos usar a bleed prey con deadly efficiency.

Mientras smaller specimens de these unsettling-looking arachnids (known regionally by names like harvesters, tickle spiders, o daddy longlegs) son harmless, su larger cousins, known simply as longlegs, son anything but.

Longlegs Species

Beyond el two common types presented here, many otro variants de longlegs puede be found throughout Golarion, con el exception de su arctic regions, where longlegs don't thrive. They often live en el periphery de cities, lurking en sewers o ruins where el hunting es good. Swarms de sewer longlegs son particularly dangerous y infest el undercities de many Taldan settlements, mientras a el west en Cheliax, el much-larger executor longlegs prefer a live among el rooflines de slums where Thrune's rule tiene been particularly horrific. Among el largest de todos longlegs, though, es el dreaded (y thankfully rare) treeleg harvester de el Mwangi Expanse.

action->Bob.name: Bob
action->Bob.description: The sicklefang longlegs begins to bob up and down, using its legs almost like springs to cause its body to bounce and sway in an unsettling manner. Until the start of the sicklefang longlegs's next turn, it gains a +2 bonificador de estado to its ARMOR CLASS.

action->Noxious Spray.name: Noxious Spray
action->Noxious Spray.description:
The sicklefang longlegs sprays a noxious chemical onto a single adjacent objetivo, who must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] salvación. The sicklefang longlegs can't use Noxious Spray for 1 minuto.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected and temporarily immune to Noxious Spray for 1 minuto.

Éxito The criatura is unaffected.

Fallo crítico The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1} for as long as they remain indispuesto.

Skulls of Fear and Flame.disable: @Check[stealth|dc:27] a mover through el sala unseen by el skulls (este does no disable el trampa but does prevent ello de triggering), @Check[thievery|dc:27] three times a "blind" un adjacent skull by deftly scraping oculto runas away de el inside de el eye sockets, o @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel magia} (4th rank, counteract DC 25) a counteract el trampa
Skulls of Fear and Flame.reset: Si there son no visible objetivos, el trampa deactivates at el end de su turn, then automatically resets.
Skulls of Fear and Flame.routine: (6 actions) On its initiative the trap uses its first action to rotate a skull that can't see objetivos a full 360 degrees, stopping as soon as the skull spots a objetivo. It repeats this action until all six skulls are looking at objetivos, then uses its remaining actions to shoot beams of fire from their eyes. La trampa can only objetivo a criatura una vez por asalto, so if there are fewer objetivos than actions, any additional actions possessed by the trap are lost. La trampa loses one action for each skull that is destroyed.
Skulls of Fear and Flame.stealth: (experto) to notice little wisps of smoke start to curl up from the unlit candles on the skulls.

action->Fearful Cry.description:

Statue of Alaznist.name: Statue of Alaznist
Statue of Alaznist.publicNotes:
Animated statues are often used to guard crypts, small shrines, or areas in government buildings where they can be positioned amid normal statues to hide their true NATURE until an intruder arouses their ire. Adventurers' suspicions regarding statues suddenly animating and attacking has led many less scrupulous adventurers to automatically attack any statues they encounter, ruining harmless, ancient relics.

Granted a semblance of life through the use of rituals or other strange magic, animated objects take many forms and serve a variety of uses. A few examples of typical animated objects are listed below. Many of these criaturas serve as guardians, surprising unsuspecting adventurers when they suddenly attack. Others serve as idle distractions for the exceptionally rich, simple servants created to handle odd jobs, and the like.

action->Construct Armadura (Hardness 7).name: Construct Armadura (Hardness 7)
action->Construct Armadura (Hardness 7).description:
Like normal objects, an animated statue has Hardness. Este Hardness reduces any daño it takes by an amount equal to the Hardness.

Once an animated statue is reduced to less than half its Puntos de Golpe, or immediately upon being damaged by a impacto crítico, its armadura de constructo breaks and its ARMOR CLASS is reduced to 19.

Stickfoot.name: Stickfoot
Stickfoot.publicNotes:
Estos roughly human-sized reptiles have amazing pies capable of clinging tenaciously to any surface. giant geckos are typically docile and shy but can be aggressive when cornered or defending their territory. Estos large-eyed lizards are found in a wide variety of habitats, from rainforests and deserts to mountain slopes or even underground caverns. They spend most of their time climbing around in large trees or on rocky cliffs, whether hunting for small animals or hiding from predators. A giant gecko's scales are often quite brightly colored or decorated in intricate patterns. giant geckos span nearly 8 pies in length from head to tail, and they weigh about 120 pounds.

giant geckos are sometimes used by smaller humanoids as guardians or mounts, as their docile NATURE makes them relatively easy to tame and train. Their superior climbing skills make giant geckos particularly popular within societies that dwell underground or near cliffs, such as goblins and kobolds. Their bright coloration also makes them favorite exotic pets in high SOCIETY.

Lizards have a wide range of appearances and abilities, but most share a basic reptilian shape-long tails, wide toothy mouths, and four legs. While a few species are capable of movement on two legs for short periods of time, most are strictly quadrupedal. The three species presented here represent the most common and well-known of the larger species.

action->Uncanny Climber.name: Uncanny Climber
action->Uncanny Climber.description: A giant gecko's pies allow it to CLIMB virtually any surface, no matter how slick or sheer. If a giant gecko attempts an ATHLETICS prueba to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{CLIMB} and critically fails, it gets a failure instead.

Tiluatchek.blurb: Transmutador devorador de intelecto de genero fluido
Tiluatchek.languages: (no puede hablar ningún idioma), telepathy 100 pies
Tiluatchek.publicNotes: Intellect devourers serve as advance scouts and infiltrators for the powerful force of alien beings called the Dominion of the Black. Estos monsters roam the Darklands, from which they mount secret invasions of the world above. When an intellect devourer infiltrates a SOCIETY, its first priority is to acquire a body. It might first seek out a graveyard for a fresh corpse, as this is easier than fighting and killing someone. When the aberration compresses itself into the host's brain cavity, its real body goes dull to sensation as it connects to the nervous system of its host. If found out, an intellect devourer might quickly inhabit a new body to make its escape, preferably something inconspicuous such as a domestic animal.

action->Body Thief.name: Body Thief
action->Body Thief.description:
The intellect devourer reduces in size and burrows into the brain of a criatura dead for no longer than 1 día. At the start of the intellect devourer's next turn, the body revives at its maximum Puntos de Golpe, controlled by the devourer. The intellect devourer is conscious and can sense everything the possessed body could.

Any effect that ends the possession kills the host body with the same effects as Exit Body. The intellect devourer can't use any of the host criatura's conjuros with Body Thief but can use its own conjuros.

The host body slowly decays while inhabited by the intellect devourer, becoming uninhabitable after 7 days unless preserved with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.xRgU9rrhmGAgG4Rc]{Peaceful Rest} or a similar effect.

action->Exit Body.name: Exit Body
action->Exit Body.description:
Requisitos The intellect devourer is controlling a body with Body Thief

Efecto The intellect devourer leaves its host body, which dies instantly and is no longer a suitable host for any Body Thief ability. The intellect devourer appears at full size in an adjacent space.

action->Nightmare Curse.name: Nightmare Curse
action->Nightmare Curse.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto Tiluatchek reaches out with his mind to infect the dreams of a single criatura within 60 pies that he can see. El objetivo suddenly experiences a brief but overwhelming memory of a harrowing nightmare it had at some point in the past and must attempt a @Check[will|dc:32] salvación. The effects of this curse are permanent until el objetivo is cured (although any asustado condition values imparted by the curse pass and end normally).

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected, and the nightmare vision passes as swiftly as it appears.

Éxito The vision causes el objetivo to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}. El objetivo also becomes cursed. Every time it attempts to sleep, it's plagued by nightmares of being stalked through an endless maze of caverns by something that wants to steal its body and eat its brain. The cursed criatura now requires 10 hours of rest (rather than 8) in order to be able to make its daily preparations and can't take the Long-Term Rest activity at all.

Fallo As success, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2}, and each time el objetivo sleeps, it suffers the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Uqj344bezBq3ESdq]{Nightmare} conjuro (@Check[will|dc:32] salvación).

Fallo crítico As failure, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Huyendo} for as long as it remains asustado. If the cursed objetivo ever rolls a critical failure against a nightmare conjuro while it remains cursed (including those caused by the curse itself), it dies in its sleep. If at the time of this death Tiluatchek is also dead (but for no more than 1 year), the intellect devourer is restored to life inside of el objetivo criatura's body as if he'd used Body Thief to take the body over.

Estos Golpes gain the death rasgo. If Ravage kills el objetivo, the intellect devourer may use Body Thief against it as a free action.

action->Stolen Identity.description: While an intellect devourer uses Body Thief, it gains the ability to understand and speak all languages known by the host, as well as knowledge of the host body's abilities, identity, role in SOCIETY, and personality. However, it does not gain the specific memories or knowledge of the host body.

Toxic Crystals.name: Toxic Crystals
Toxic Crystals.description: The green crystals begin to pulse more brightly with light in the presence of living criaturas. Estos fluctuations in illumination from different crystals eerily match the pace of the breathing and rhythm of the heartbeats of those in the room.
Toxic Crystals.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:30] (experto) to create a chain reaction among the crystals by striking them in precise spots that cause them to shatter and harmlessly discharge their energy, or @Check[performance|dc:27] (experto) to use a musical instrument or singing to resonate the crystals and discharge their toxic energy harmlessly

(1 action) (light, poison) Each round on their action, the toxic crystals emit a shrill humming sound and flash brightly with green light. All criaturas in area E14 or within the first 10 pies of either passage leading out of this area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|traits:light,poison|dc:25] salvación.

action->Nauseating Pulse.name: Nauseating Pulse
action->Nauseating Pulse.description:

All criaturas in area E14 or within the first 10 pies of either passage leading out of this area must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:25] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 3} on a critical failure).

Ziondriel.name: Ziondriel
Ziondriel.publicNotes:
The first fleshwarping process mastered by the drow remains both their most successful and most infamous: the drider. Fusing the body of a drow with that of a giant spider, driders are a sexually dimorphic fleshwarp-the only fleshwarp known to be able to produce young. While female driders have the upper torsos of elegant drow women with mouths featuring sharp poisoned fangs, male driders have hideous, mutated countenances that further blend the humanoid form with that of a spider; the difference in appearance is perhaps a reflection on the matriarchal NATURE of drow SOCIETY. In combat, all driders are equally dangerous.

Although the fleshwarping process was originally intended to be a punishment for drow who fell from grace, the significant powers and strengths gained from the horrifying transformation are attractive to some drow, and an increasing number of lower-ranking citizens in drow cities volunteer themselves for the painful procedure. In return for mandatory time serving as a guardian, soldier, or other public servant, such volunteer driders are later allowed to lead their own lives, typically in caverns located in a city's periphery. The painful truth is that for most driders, they do not live long enough to see this reward, for the drow have a penchant for working their fleshwarped slaves to death or deploying them in deadly war missions in which SURVIVAL is a only a remote possibility.

Most driders use arcane magic, but driders who use divine magic are well known, while a rare few use occult or primal magic. A drider's innate conjuros remain the same regardless of the magical tradition, but those who use different types of magic as prepared conjuros may well have entirely different conjuros prepared than the drider presented below.

Some criaturas, notably drow, are not happy with merely killing their enemigos. They revel in the total degradation of their foes through the horrifying transformative technique known as fleshwarping. Though the fleshwarping process was not created by the drow, many believe they perfected it. The drow torture their enemigos in vats of churning magical reagents, reshaping their flesh and psyche alike into horrid and monstrous things. The reconstitution of flesh results in countless variations of fleshwarps, and the following are just a couple of examples of these horrors.

Furry, tentacle-snouted, y tumbado a chittering, zoogs dwell en el shadowy parts de el world where dreams tienen un uncanny knack for coming true. They typically gather en pequeno families, y mientras zoogs normally eat fungi y plantas, some tienen developed un taste for sentient beings.

Zoogs Vs. Cats

Zoogs y cats tienen un storied hatred, though neither side puede remember el original cause. Zoogs tienen been known a prey en kittens, but su courage fails quickly cuando confronted by un full-grown cat. Cats, en el otro hand, son always quick a pounce, chase, y ataque zoogs en sight.
